Definition: Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hashub = "considerate"; 1) a Merarite Levite chief, son of Azrikam; 2) a son of Pahath-moab who assisted in the repair of the wall of Jerusalem; 3) a man who assisted in the repair of the wall of Jerusalem; may be same as 2 above; 4) one of the heads of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
